AZR_MarinePark.text: AZURE REACH MARINE PARK — A large, glossy, popular, well-funded modern marine park built for public wonder, conservation messaging, sponsors, livestreams, and curated spectacle. Glass, water, bright architecture, professional signage, large crowds, and beautiful animal habitats. Public magic is immaculate; backstage spaces are clean, competent, and functional, never grimy or dystopian.
